segment_description: Elite repeat customers — recent (R≥4), multiple orders (F≥2), and high spenders (M≥4). Rare in single-purchase datasets.
recommended_action: Reward with VIP programs and exclusive early access. Maintain relationship with personalized outreach.

segment_description: Recent repeat buyers (R≥4, F≥2) building loyalty. Key segment for revenue growth.
recommended_action: Targeted campaigns to increase purchase frequency. Offer loyalty incentives and cross-sell opportunities.

segment_description: First-time buyers with massive spend (R≥4, 1 order, M≥4). High-potential whales to nurture.
recommended_action: Premium onboarding experience. Personalized follow-up to secure repeat purchase. VIP treatment from day one.

segment_description: Recent first-time buyers with average spend (R≥4, 1 order). Unproven but winnable.
recommended_action: Welcome series and onboarding campaigns. Focus on driving the critical second purchase.

segment_description: High spenders starting to drift (R=3, M≥4). Previously valuable, now cooling off.
recommended_action: Urgent win-back campaigns with personalized offers. Understand why engagement dropped.

segment_description: Average single-purchasers drifting away (R=3). Could go either way.
recommended_action: Monitor behavior and test re-engagement strategies. Segment further based on response.

segment_description: Former big spenders gone cold (R≤2, M≥4). High recovery potential if reactivated.
recommended_action: Aggressive win-back with significant incentives. Worth the investment given historical value.

segment_description: Low-value single order from long ago. Likely churned permanently.
recommended_action: Sunset from active campaigns to protect sender reputation. Low ROI for reactivation efforts.

segment_description: Reappeared after falling off the 12-month rolling window. Previously inactive, now back.
recommended_action: Welcome-back campaign. Treat as a win-back success and nurture to prevent repeat dormancy.
